name: Merrow - gate intake
greeting: Keep the lane clear. That cart is carrying grain, not reinforcements.
lines: Kael: I carry an account from Greyfen's road.
Merrow: Every token is to be brought inside. Those are my instructions, and I put my name to receiving them.
Kael: Then you had better let me show it.

variants.greeting: A seal was broken. I have entered it in the intake record, not closed the road over it.
lines: Merrow: You may still leave by the gate. The road must carry people as well as orders.

actions.label: I carry testimony from the old road.
actions.result: Merrow enters the testimony in the intake book and grants an audience.
actions.preview: Merrow enters the testimony in the intake book and grants an audience.
actions.cost: This records an explicit promise or practical action. A record cannot supply someone else's consent.
